WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: The token a system user holds. Meta says to store it somewhere secure. A temporary one expires quickly and is not meant for real use. All names here are convention: Meta's samples use placeholders, not variables.

WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.description: Meta says never to share your app secret with anyone. Resetting it in the dashboard invalidates the old one at once.

WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.description: Which number sends. Meta states no sensitivity for this or the two ids below, so none of them is treated as public here.

WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Which business account the number belongs to.

WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN.description: A string you choose, which Meta echoes back when it verifies your webhook. You pick it, so nothing stops you picking something guessable.
